title: Calcium–albumin interaction fails to add PTH prediction across two NHANES cycles
abstract: A calcium-by-albumin interaction did not improve log-PTH prediction beyond additive nonlinear standard measurements: source PSU-grouped cross-validation MSE reduction -0.00035928; frozen transfer from 4,358 NHANES 2003–04 adults to 4,394 adults in 2005–06 gave reduction -0.00021916 (fixed-fit PSU-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.00065501, 0.00019184]; two-sample refit interval [-0.00215058, 0.00057972]). These independent-cycle, within-program results do not demonstrate incremental value; external-program confirmation and ionized-calcium inference remain unavailable.
